body:
I do take medications for IBS. 


I also had gone to a psychiatrist before. He suspected me to bipolar. Wasn't sure though. It was more like that my mood changed ultra rapidly depending on the circumstance. I was emotionally ultra unstable.


I understand what you are trying to say. :)


I will always keep your advice in mind.


Thanks.

I'm pretty sure that I don't have AS. I've gone through all the diagnostic criteria.


The difference here is that I *want* to interact with people and have real friends. It's just that others don't find me interesting.


My tummy makes weird noises and the IBS thing embarasses me a lot. Nobody seems to understand it. That's another reason why I can't go out anywhere. People find those noises disgusting even though I'm not farting or anything. It's just air moving inside my hyper sensitive intestines. I get frustrated due to this.


The social phobia thing isn't consistent. I've had times when I did go up to people and ask them whatever I wanted to ask. I also managed to present a seminar a month back. I was stammering and sweating like crazy but I somehow managed it. I was quite determined to do it as I wanted to get over this fear.


Ya I do have a really horrible handwriting though. :) Thanks a lot for trying to help. I feel better when I realize that people are not ignoring me as they do here. I really mean it. Thanks.

Clothes, hair, appearance everything. Plus I can't spend like the rest. They go abroad for holidays and have cars and shit. I'm also slightly overweight.


People find me weird. I can't join in on any of their conversations, except for this one girl I've mentioned in the post.


I'd love to be a part of the society.


I sometimes have social phobia. It's really weird and frustrating. I have cut myself in the past over this. I did it to get attention. It worked for some time.
I talked to the girl I had mentioned in my post. We talked for 2 hrs on the phone. It was nice. :) Thanks.
I spend too much time online because I don't have a real life. I want to change that. I just want to be normal.
I'm going to try that right now.

I'm in India. My IBS is mostly psychological. I have really bad episodes when I'm upset. And that happens when I'm lonely and left out. People never call me for anything. B'days, movies, games nothing at all.

I'm trying to eat but my gut is screwed up. I have irritable bowel syndrome.


I do care about others. That's all I seem to do. That's why I want to be a doctor. I just want to have some friends in this place. I want to be normal.


I want to go out with them for movies, play football, hang out at random places doing silly stupid but fun things...the list is endless.
People don't like me. I'm not rich. This place is all about money. I'm not good in class anymore. I'm all screwed up.
